item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 14/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Upper-air disturbances will also bring a few showers and thunderstorms to the region. The northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China midweek next week. Meanwhile, a broad trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the seas near Luzon, and there may be development of an area of low pressure, but there are uncertainties in its subsequent movement. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Bebinca will move across the East China Sea in the next couple of days. It will then move towards the coast of eastern China.
